title: Teriyaki Spring Onion Burgers
changes_from_base: Togarashi-seasoned patties are glazed with my own home-made soy, honey and ginger teriyaki, rolled in sliced spring onion and served with mayonnaise and shredded cabbage instead of cheese.
summary: Smoky beef coated in glossy teriyaki and sprinkled with Japanese seven-spice comes topped with creamy mayo, shredded cabbage and spring onion.

ingredients.item: cornflour mixed with 1 tbsp cold water
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Glaze
steps.text: Simmer 80 ml soy sauce, 60 ml water, 2 tbsp light brown sugar, 1 tbsp honey, 1 tsp finely grated fresh ginger and 1 finely grated garlic clove in a small pan for 2 min, whisk in a slurry of 1 tsp cornflour mixed with 1 tbsp cold water and bubble for 1 min until glossy; cool.

steps.title: Shape
steps.text: Shape 680 g beef chuck mince into 4 patties about 1 cm wider than the buns with a slight dip in the centre, season with 1 tsp fine salt and 2 tsp shichimi togarashi and chill until needed.

steps.title: Cook
steps.text: Heat a barbecue with one hot zone (or a griddle pan over high), cook the patties over the hot side turning now and then for 5-7 min until well charred; then brush both sides with teriyaki and keep turning and brushing until 71 °C in the centre.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Lift the patties onto 140 g green cabbage very finely shredded and spread over a large plate, brush with more sauce and turn to coat in cabbage.

steps.title: Assemble
steps.text: Spread 4 tbsp mayonnaise on both halves of the buns, put half the cabbage on the bases, add patties, brush with a little more sauce, top with the rest of the cabbage, close and serve.

tips: Brief toasting of shichimi togarashi in a dry pan enhances its fragrance.
Keep spring onions separate and coat patties just before serving to stay crisp.
Make the glaze up to 3 days ahead; reheat gently before brushing on.
storage: Cooked patties keep for 2 days refrigerated; the teriyaki glaze keeps for up to 4 days in a separate container. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
